changelog:
Your data stays put unless you ask for it to be shared. Connecting a Google account no longer starts sending things to Google: linking Google Calendar used to begin writing your events there straight away, and linking Google Tasks began pushing your to-dos. Both now wait until you switch them on in Settings, so your phone behaves the way your PC always has.

Read your documents on your phone. The new Documents screen shows everything DensAssistant has indexed from folders on your PC - your Google Drive folder, your Documents - searchable and readable here. Anything you open is saved to the phone, so you can still read it later with your PC asleep, and it tells you plainly when you're looking at a saved copy.

Repeating events are fixed. A repeating event used to fill the month view with hundreds of duplicate entries a second apart, and a monthly reminder starting on the 31st drifted a few days later every month. Both fixed. Richer schedules now work too - every other Tuesday, the third Friday, the last day of the month - and a repeating event you create here now stays repeating when it reaches your PC, where it used to arrive as a one-off.

Calendar invites: open an .ics from your email and it becomes a real event, offline, with no account connected. Share your month back out the same way.

Accessibility: the Documents and Calendar screens now work properly with TalkBack. Buttons say what they do, and the calendar reads out each day with what's on it ("14 September, today, 3 items") instead of just a number.
